hero.tagline: IF YOU CAN'T BEAT US, JOIN US!

welcome.title: Welcome to US
welcome.p: The Amstelcampushal is the second home for US members. Here we shoot hoops both on the court and in the canteen. With our six women's and six men's teams you'll always find a fun group at your level (18+).

join.title: Join US
join.p: US Basketball has 12 fantastic women's and men's teams that take the court every week! Do you love basketball and the social scene? Then you've come to the right place at U.S. Basketbal! At U.S. you can train along for free twice to find the team that suits you best.

About.title: About our club
About.intro: Since 1951 U.S. Basketball has been one of the basketball clubs in Amsterdam. Our motto is "if you can't beat us, join US". Consider yourself warned: U.S. will feel like an extra family! After trainings and matches you'll find many members in the clubhouse for the third half, or in the stands cheering on the other teams. A wonderful mix of competition and cosiness where everyone feels at home.

competition.title: Competition teams
competition.intro: All competition teams train 75 minutes on Wednesday evening; some teams also train on Friday evening. Home games are played on Sundays at the Amstelcampushal.
competition.playingP: Play matches for a competition team in the NBB competition, every week during the season.
competition.trainingP: Train with a competition team without playing matches. As a training member you can play a maximum of 3 games per season.
competition.resultsP: Want to know where the U.S. teams stand in the competition or which league they play in? All results, standings and match schedules can be found on <link>basketball.nl</link>.

recreation.title: Recreational teams
recreation.p: Prefer to play basketball without matches? Join our enthusiastic recreational team, which trains on Tuesday and Thursday evenings in the Apollohal.

About.note: Note: US only has senior teams (18+). We do NOT offer youth basketball.

Membership.title: Membership
Membership.intro: Below you'll find all the information about joining, membership fees, kits and deregistering at US Basketball.

join.title: Join US
join.p1: Love basketball and good vibes? Then you're in the right place at U.S. Basketbal! You can train along twice for free to find the team that suits you best. Fill in the interest form and we'll invite you to a trial training.
join.p2: Played at another club in the last 5 years? Make sure you're deregistered there and free of any debts. The statement of no debt is arranged online via basketball.nl.

fees.title: Membership fees
fees.intro: These are the membership fees at US
fees.matchIntro: Play matches for US. Your contribution depends on how many times your team trains per week.
fees.studentNote: Students get 10% discount on their membership fee at US.

timing.full: Joining between 1 August and 31 December: full season membership fee.
timing.reduced: Joining between 1 January and 31 March: reduced season membership fee.

merch.title: Kits and merchandise
merch.p: Looking for a new kit? Or would you like some of that awesome US merchandise!? Take a look at <shopLink>Basketball Totaal</shopLink>.

leave.title: Leave US
leave.p1: Want to leave U.S.? Send an email to <email>secretaris@usbasketball.nl</email> with your cancellation. This is the only way to officially cancel! If you don't deregister, you will keep paying your membership fee (even if you've told your coach and team).
leave.p2: Cancellation of your membership for the new season must be done before 1 May. There is no refund of membership fees in case of mid-season cancellation after the start of the season (1 September). If you cancel after 1 May, a one-off fee of €50 applies, see below.

matchRows.r1: Period 1 September - 30 April: full year membership fee for the current season is due

recRows.r1: Period 1 September - 31 December: membership fee for half a season is due
recRows.r2: Period 1 January - 31 August: full membership fee for the current season is due

leave.disclaimer: Disclaimer regarding deregistering at US: When you deregister, you give up all your rights to play in a team. The board assumes there is a spot in a team and will forward new registrations to this team. When you register again, you therefore have no priority over new members.

cta.title: Become a member
cta.description: Signing up only takes a few minutes.

who.title: Who are we?
who.p: US Basketball NL is the data controller for the personal data processed on this website and in our administration. You can reach us via bestuur@usbasketball.nl.

data.title: What data do we collect?
data.p: When you register as a member we collect your first and last name, email address, phone number and the team you play in. When you use the website we may process analytics data (anonymised).

purpose.title: What do we use your data for?
purpose.p: We process your data to manage your membership, communicate about trainings and matches, process the season fee and comply with legal obligations. We never sell your data to third parties.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p: You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, and the right to object to certain processing. You can exercise these rights by contacting the board. If you have a complaint you can contact the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

retention.title: How long do we keep your data?
retention.p: We keep membership data for as long as you are a member and up to one year after deregistration. Financial records are kept as required by law.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.p: This website uses cookies. Analytical cookies (such as GA4) are only placed after you give consent via the cookie banner. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.intro: Quick answers about joining US Basketball, membership fees, training times and more.
FAQ.cta: Still interested? Fill in the interest form and we'll invite you to a trial training.

age.question: Who can join US Basketball?
age.answer: US Basketball is for adults aged 18 and over. We have no youth teams — all our members play in senior teams.

join.question: How do I become a member?
join.answer: Fill in the interest form on our website. Our committee will review your submission and invite you to a trial training. After that we match you to a team that fits your level and preferences.

trial.question: Can I try before I join?
trial.answer: Yes. You can train along for free twice to see which team suits you best before deciding to become a member.

fees.question: What are the membership fees?
fees.answer: Competition members pay €330 (trains 2× per week), €300 (1.5× per week) or €270 (1× per week) per season. Recreational members who train without playing matches pay €170 per season.

student.question: Is there a student discount?
student.answer: Yes. Students receive a 10% discount on their membership fee.

training.question: When and where do teams train?
training.answer: Competition teams train on Wednesday evenings (75 minutes) at the Amstelcampushal; some teams also train on Friday. Home games are played on Sundays at the Amstelcampushal. Our recreational team trains on Tuesday and Thursday evenings at the Apollohal.

competition.question: What is the difference between a playing member and a training member?
competition.answer: A playing member competes in NBB league matches every week during the season. A training member trains with a competition team but does not play matches — they may play a maximum of 3 games per season.

cancel.question: How do I cancel my membership?
cancel.answer: Send an email to secretaris@usbasketball.nl — this is the only official way to cancel. Cancellation for the new season must be done before 1 May. Cancelling after 1 May costs a one-off fee of €50. No membership fees are refunded for mid-season cancellation after the season starts on 1 September.
